Silový trénink snížil výskyt sportovních: Strength training cut sports injuries to less than a third and overuse injuries to about a half (Lauersen et al., 2014), with a larger effect at higher volume and intensity (Lauersen et al., 2018). In endurance runners it improves running economy, best with heavy loads two to three times a week (Blagrove et al., 2018; Rønnestad & Mujika, 2014). Tendons adapt to high loads applied slowly and for longer (Bohm et al., 2015). Progression by how the end of the session felt follows the effort scale and repetitions in reserve (Foster et al., 2001; Helms et al., 2016). Heavy leg strength work impairs hard running over the next 24–48 hours, so session A never comes the day before one (Doma et al., 2017). A drop of the pelvis on the free-leg side was the movement trait most strongly linked with running injuries (Bramah et al., 2018), and eight weeks of functional hip abductor strengthening reduced it in runners with shin pain more than physiotherapy alone (Lashien et al., 2024), so the programme includes the monster walk (session A) and the hip hitch on a step and the side plank with leg raise (session B).
